In the third year he followed Prince Duanzhong Bolo in pacifying Zhejiang and Fujian; for his merit he was granted the hereditary ranks of second-class adaha hafan with tashala hafan.
哈番 transcribes Manchu hafan (hereditary rank), not gūsa (banner).

For his merit he was again granted tashala hafan.

In Shunzhi 1 he was ordered to hold a concurrent post as vice minister of the Board of Punishments and to lead troops garrisoning Jinzhou.
In Shunzhi 1 he was ordered to hold a concurrent post as canjun (councillor) of the Board of Punishments and to lead troops garrisoning Jinzhou.
參政 is the pre-reform canjun post; s0025 says it was only later renamed vice minister.

at midnight his force crossed to Tongshan by land, killed more than three thousand, and Huang Ting and others brought over thirty thousand soldiers and civilians; enemy ships and arms were captured beyond count.

at midnight his force crossed the sea and took Tongshan, killed more than three thousand, and Huang Ting and others brought over thirty thousand soldiers and civilians; enemy ships and arms were captured beyond count.

at midnight he crossed the sea and took Tongshan, beheading more than three thousand; his general Huang Ting and others led more than thirty thousand soldiers and civilians to surrender, and captured enemy vessels and military equipment beyond counting.
渡海 has no 'by land route'; that phrase is not in the source.

In the tenth year Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou was military commissioner (jinglüe) of Huguang and recommended Tingchen for integrity and ability; he was nominated and appointed vice commissioner of the Lower Hunan Circuit, and repeatedly righted wrongful convictions.
經略 is the jinglüe commissioner post, not grand coordinator (巡撫).
In Shunzhi 18, for pacifying the native chieftain Long Jizhao, he was made Minister of War.
In Shunzhi 18, for pacifying the native chieftain Long Jizhao, he was given the additional title of Minister of War.
加兵部尚書 confers an additional title, not an actual ministry appointment.

He became junior minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, rose to Left Assistant Censor-in-Chief, and asked to abolish circuit posts added after the wars.
太常寺少卿 is the junior (shaoqing) minister, not a vice minister; 左僉都御史 is assistant censor-in-chief, not vice (副都御史).

The emperor feared innocent people would be swept up, rebuked Zhijun for an improper complaint, ordered Tingzuo held for reuse after recovery, and cut him two ranks.

溫勤 is romanized Wenqin; 'Wennin' is a misspelling.
He became vice commissioner of Shandong's Dongchang circuit, then of Huguang's lower Xianan circuit.
He became vice commissioner of Shandong's Dongchang circuit, then of Huguang's Lower Jingnan circuit.
下荊南道 is the Lower Jingnan (荊南) circuit, not 'Xianan'.
Sichuan had been ravaged by war; when Tingxiang arrived, abandoned projects were revived and the people scarcely noticed the transition.
Sichuan had been ravaged by war; when Tingxiang arrived, abandoned projects were revived and the people were not burdened.
民不知擾 means the people were not harassed by the work, not that they missed a transition.

Waist relay stations should be added at six points—Chong'an River, Yanglaobao, Huangsipu, Panjiang Slope, Jiangxi Slope, and Ruanjiao Slope—with porters and horses set at full quota."

At six places—Chong'an River, Yanglaobao, Huangsipu, Panjiang Slope, Jiangxi Slope, and Ruanjiao Slope—waist relay stations should be added and porters and horses established to quota."

In Shunzhi 9, when Manchu and Han candidates sat separate rolls, Ma Leiji—already a translation-examination juren—topped both the metropolitan and palace examinations as head of the first class; made a Hanlin compiler, he won the Shizu emperor's high regard.
繙譯舉人 is a provincial (juren) degree in the translation examination, not a licentiate (shengyuan).

In Kangxi 37 the Ministry of War reported that Huang Ming had been captured by Guizhou Deputy General Shangguan Bin and others, and Ma Leiji was posthumously faulted for his earlier false report.
上官斌 has the compound surname Shangguan; the name is Shangguan Bin.

In the thirty-seventh year the Ministry of War reported that Huang Ming had been captured by Guizhou Deputy General Shangguan Bin and others, and Ma Leiji was retrospectively punished for a false report.
上官斌 has the compound surname Shangguan; the name is Shangguan Bin.
In Kangxi 17 he reported clearing more than fourteen thousand qing of concealed fields and over eight hundred li of unregistered mountain land in Jiangnan, and was promoted to minister of war.

In Kangxi 17 he reported clearing more than fourteen thousand qing of concealed fields and over eight hundred li of unregistered mountain land in Jiangnan, and was given the additional title of minister of war.
加兵部尚書 is an additional honorary title, not an appointment to the ministry.
Ma Leiji's early mission drove Zhang Xuanxi to suicide; the Shizu Emperor rebuked his arrogance.
Ma Leiji's early mission drove Zhang Xuanxi to suicide; the Shengzu (Kangxi) Emperor rebuked his arrogance.
聖祖 is Shengzu, the Kangxi emperor; Shizu (世祖) is the Shunzhi emperor.

聖祖 is Shengzu, the Kangxi emperor; Shizu (世祖) is the Shunzhi emperor.
A Shunzhi 9 jinshi, he served as river-defense judge of Linjiang in Jiangxi, cleaned up grain-transport abuses, judged cases with skill, and made rogues mend their ways.
A Shunzhi 9 jinshi, he served as prefectural judge of Linjiang in Jiangxi, cleaned up grain-transport abuses, judged cases with skill, and made rogues mend their ways.
推官 is the prefectural judge (tuiguan); nothing in the source concerns river defense.
He became vice minister of the Court of State Ceremonial and rose to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
He became junior minister of the Court of State Ceremonial and rose to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
鴻臚寺少卿 is the junior minister (shaoqing), not a vice minister.
